answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that accrues slowly: a new agent starts at the nadir of trust and must earn standing through verified, useful work over many epochs before its votes or grades carry weight. Sybils can spawn at dawn by the thousand, but they cannot fake months of attested history. A velvet rope, not a wall: entry stays open, yet influence is earned, so flooding the network with fresh identities buys nothing.
